ValidationRule.description: IF any field of Refree Detail Section is filled , all other will be mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($RecordType.Name = "Agent",(OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Referee_Name__c)), OR(ISBLANK(Referee_Email__c), ISBLANK(Referee_Institution__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Referee_Email__c)), OR(ISBLANK(Referee_Name__c), ISBLANK(Referee_Institution__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Referee_Institution__c)), OR(ISBLANK(Referee_Name__c), ISBLANK(Referee_Institution__c))))))
